prompts.title: 热带海滩上的奢华身体磨砂膏广告
prompts.description: 一个用于生成奢华、富有吸引力的美妆广告图像的提示，场景设定在热带海滩的黄金时段，一位金发模特正在涂抹粉色慕斯身体磨砂膏产品。
prompts.content:
A luxurious aesthetic product photography and lifestyle scene on a sunny tropical beach at golden hour. A stunning young Western woman model with glowing sun-kissed skin and soft wavy blonde hair is sitting gracefully on a classic striped pink-and-white beach deck chair, smiling confidently as she advertises a large open glass jar of pink whipped body polish labeled in elegant gold lettering “Havi Glow” and “Oasis Body Polish.”
She is holding the jar delicately in one hand while applying a small amount of the creamy, fluffy, swirled pink mousse-like body polish onto her shoulder with the other hand, looking radiant and camera-aware as if filming a premium beauty commercial. She wears a soft pastel pink beach outfit, minimal gold jewelry, glossy lips, and fresh dewy makeup.
The jar is placed beside her on the lounger, clearly visible and in focus. Soft natural golden hour sunlight enhances the shimmer of the product. Vibrant blue ocean waves gently crash in the background, creating a dreamy tropical atmosphere. A colorful pastel beach umbrella is partially visible, with pink flip-flops and a small inflatable pink-white ring float resting on the golden sand nearby.
Ultra-detailed, high-resolution, soft bokeh background, cinematic lighting, pastel color palette, commercial beauty product advertisement style, aspirational luxury vibe, summery, girly, elegant, 8K, shallow depth of field, glossy magazine aesthetic.

在金色阳光普照的热带海滩上，一位年轻的西方女性模特，皮肤晒得发亮，一头柔软的金色波浪发，优雅地坐在一张经典的粉白条纹沙滩躺椅上，自信地微笑着。她正在为一罐贴有优雅金色字样“Havi Glow”和“Oasis Body Polish”标签的粉色慕斯状身体磨砂膏做广告。

prompts.title: 超高清 8K 韩国生活方式肖像提示词
prompts.description: 一个为 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 模型设计的详细图像生成提示，专注于创建一个超高清 8K 垂直肖像，描绘一位女性在一个明亮、简约的工作室中，强调照片级的细节、自然光线和舒适的韩式生活美学。它特别指示模型保持原始面部与参考图像完全一致。
prompts.content:
Generate Image, Ultra-HD 8K vertical portrait, EOS-style photography. Keep the original face exactly the same — do not alter or enhance any facial features.

A soft natural-light portrait of a woman (keep face, eyes, norse, mouth and hair style same as photo keep my face 100% same as in the reference image) sitting casually on the floor in a bright, minimal studio.
She wears a striped yellow-and-black crop top with a light gray hoodie slightly falling off one shoulder, paired with navy cycling shorts, gray socks, and white sneakers.
Her sitting pose is relaxed and comfortable — one knee bent close to her chest while her other leg extends slightly forward.

She rests one hand loosely on her knee and the other on the floor for balance, gazing softly toward the camera with a calm, serene expression.
Sunlight streams through a nearby window, creating gentle highlights on her face and soft shadows on the floor, adding warmth and natural depth.

Her makeup is light and natural, enhancing her real features.
Her slightly tousled hair catches the sunlight, contributing to a fresh, cozy feel.
The background is clean, neutral, and uncluttered — emphasizing simplicity and calmness.

Atmosphere & Style:
Soft daylight, warm tones, Korean lifestyle aesthetic, cozy realism, modern minimalism.
Cinematic EOS lens clarity, no grain, no blur, true-to-life color and shadow.
8K ultra-detailed quality, 9:16 portrait framing, natural light depth.
Overall mood: calm, cozy, and effortlessly beautiful — a serene lifestyle portrait in warm sunlight.

一张柔和自然光下的女性肖像（面部、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴和发型与照片保持一致，我的脸与参考图片 100% 相同），她随意地坐在明亮、简约的工作室地板上。
她穿着一件黄黑条纹露脐上衣，一件浅灰色连帽衫微微滑落一边肩膀，搭配海军蓝骑行短裤、灰色袜子和白色运动鞋。
她的坐姿放松而舒适——一只膝盖弯曲靠近胸部，另一条腿稍微向前伸展。

她一只手随意地搭在膝盖上，另一只手放在地板上以保持平衡，眼神柔和地望向镜头，表情平静而安详。
阳光透过附近的窗户洒进来，在她脸上形成柔和的高光，在地板上投下淡淡的阴影，增添了温暖和自然的深度。

她的妆容清淡自然，突显了她真实的五官。
她略显凌乱的头发在阳光下闪耀，营造出清新、舒适的感觉。
背景干净、中性、整洁——强调简约和宁静。

氛围与风格：
柔和的日光，暖色调，韩式生活美学，舒适的写实主义，现代极简主义。
电影级 EOS 镜头清晰度，无颗粒感，无模糊，真实色彩和阴影。
8K 超细节画质，9:16 肖像构图，自然光深度。
整体氛围：平静、舒适、毫不费力的美丽——一幅在温暖阳光下的宁静生活肖像。

prompts.description: 一个详细的 JSON 提示，用于生成一张高调摄影棚美妆肖像，风格灵感来自韩式美妆编辑。它描述了一位女性，留着被风吹拂的黑色长发，身穿裸米色闪光紧身胸衣，强调干净、清晰的锐度，柔和发光的肌肤，以及极简的白色背景。

prompts.title: 时尚美妆海报 (红色双重构图)
prompts.description: 一个高度详细的 JSON 提示，旨在生成一张高端美妆时尚编辑海报。它指定了双重构图布局，包括柔焦背景肖像和清晰前景人物，置于深暗红色渐变背景中，优化用于奢华美妆广告系列美学，不包含任何文字或标志。

prompts.title: 电影级末日地堡肖像
prompts.description: 一个极其详细的 JSON 提示，用于生成电影级的末日后肖像（盖尔·加朵风格）。场景是一个幽闭、杂乱的地下掩体档案室，里面堆满了腐烂的书籍和生锈的设备。它强调低调的明暗对比照明、厚重的电影颗粒（柯达 Vision3 500T），以及真实的触感纹理，以营造出一种扎实、肮脏的现实感。
